vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."

"Hey." A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 60s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a limp telling A man, maybe 40s, with a broad frame about A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
👥 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm walks out with Zuri. "Nobody walks alone today."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't bother arguing anymore. By dusk the Fish crews are taking orders from them, and nobody quite remembers when it changed.

"Enough," A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. "I want a say in how this village runs. A real say."

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about the humming in the grass. Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Owen taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Owen drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder The Big Beast falls.

It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
